strategy_rationale: No time column and no group column detected. 3 classes with balanced distribution (33.33% minority rate). Stratified K-Fold (k=5) preserves class proportions across folds, mirroring the balanced val.csv held-out evaluation. Each fold has ~24 rows with equal representation of all classes, which is the best simulation of the hidden evaluation on the balanced val.csv test set.
simulates_hidden_evaluation: Stratified 5-fold CV on 120 training rows maintains class balance in each validation fold, matching the balanced 3-class distribution of val.csv (10 samples per class). OOF predictions cover all training rows and are scored on the same accuracy metric as the held-out val.

leakage_risks.action: Exclude species from all feature sets; it is a string encoding of the target label.

validation_limitations: Stratified K-Fold assumes i.i.d. draws. The 1 duplicate row in training is a minor concern but negligible at this dataset size. No distribution shift detected between train and val.
